notes.title: A Robot's Journey Demo - Q&A with the Developer #2
notes.content:
Join me (Daniel); the developer of A Robot's Journey, as well as the music composer (Bryan), while I play the demo. I will discuss the development process of making the game, how the last year has been balancing work, family, baby, and game development, including the ups and downs.

I will also be answering any of your questions. I look forward to hearing from you. Hope you will enjoy it.

notes.title: New update to A Robot's Journey Demo
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39109368/a37cb509cba846bf4a1bfc55bb894f1b9ac42802.png[/img]

Thank you to those who have played my game and left feedback so I can continue to improve A Robot's Journey. Here is a list of various bug fixes that were resolved in the latest patch.

- Remove FPS counter
- Made it more clear where to go in Rain level
- Energy HUD disappeared during level. Fixed
- extended wait time on idle animation
- Storm gate opens correctly now
- updated fragment counter to indicate the proper amount of fragments to collect
- After Play game button is pressed the 'hover' over sound effect is still heard when mouse is moved
- Monolith glow is only visible on side that can be activated
- changed menu hovered icon to circle instead of straight line
- Controls menu - mouse can now click on checkbox instead of text
- Graphics setting now save throughout levels
- on second playthrough, backspace to skip cutscene, player would end up in white limbo. This no longer happens
- Re-positioned starting location in Rain level to make it more clear where to go

notes.title: New update to A Robot's Journey Demo
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39109368/c541cb128b8097f6eca17ac8ba13aae8c9cd1639.png[/img]
Thank you to those who have played my game and left feedback so I can continue to improve A Robot's Journey. Here is a list of additions and bug fixes.

- Add voice over and subtitles to monolith interaction
- Add a Feedback button on main menu that links to Steam forum
- Move trigger at end of demo to prevent player from finishing the game without activating the 3 lake platforms.
- Remove zoom camera functionality
- 'press backspace to skip' now fades away and no longer remains on screen
- Add functionality to 'Brightness slider' in graphics setting
